about: Every distance-2 row of the level-3 table of the larger unified borrowed-identity search, rebuilt and checked by borrowed_identities/export_large_unified.py. Cite S. Singh, C. Gidney and C. Jones, "Borrowed Identities: Malleable Distillation Factories and a Unified Numerical Search," arXiv:2606.28518 (2026).
conventions: n counts the input T states and N (wires) the circuit wires, as in the upstream table; wires 0..k-1 are the outputs. A two-group row gives its circuit as construction, which builds its columns (master_catalog/constructions.py), with columns_sha256 the SHA-256 of them as compact JSON; every rotation of it is one T. A gluing row gives gates, each [support, c] the parity rotation by c*pi/8 on its support, c modulo 8; the odd-c gates consume T states and are the columns, and even-c gates are Clifford. d is measured here over the columns, with d_witness the column indices of an undetectable damaging fault of that weight, and A_d is the number of such faults.
